# HYPE

> Cork creative agency making brand films, documentaries and social media content for hospitality, leisure and property brands across Ireland.

HYPE (legally HYPE Marketing & Media Ltd., trading as HYPE Films, Media & Marketing) is a Cork-based creative agency serving 22+ active clients. Founded by Tiago Carvalho (CEO & Co-founder) and Andrea Williams (Co-founder & Content Director). Winner of Best Use of Digital by a Start-Up at the Cork Digital Marketing Awards 2020. Every message answered within 24 hours.

## Services

- [Social media management in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/social-media-management-cork): Monthly on-location shoots, posting on every platform, community management and ads. From €2,700/month + VAT on a six-month contract.
- [Paid social ads in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/paid-social-ads-cork): Facebook, Instagram and TikTok ads set up, monitored and reported inside the HYPE social media retainer. Ad budget paid directly to Meta or TikTok.
- [Content creation in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/content-creation-cork): A content creator for your business, without hiring one. Monthly shoots, Reels, carousels, events coverage, inside the €2,700/month social retainer.
- [Brand film production](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/brand-films-ireland): Brand films and documentaries for Cork and Irish brands. Shot on location, cut for social. From €3,300 + VAT.
- [Video production in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/video-production-cork): Videography, commercials, documentaries and social cuts. From €3,300 + VAT.
- [Corporate video production in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/corporate-video-production-cork): Recruitment, company culture and event films. About three weeks from shoot. From €3,300 + VAT.
- [Documentary production in Ireland](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/documentary-production-ireland): Up to 30 minutes. About six weeks for films over 15 minutes. Quoted to scope, from €3,300 + VAT.
- [PR agency in Cork](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/pr-agency-cork): PR and brand positioning for launches, reopenings and brand pivots. From €3,300 + VAT.
- [Hospitality marketing in Ireland](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/hospitality-marketing-ireland): Film, social and PR for Irish hotels, restaurants and bars. From €2,700/month + VAT.
- [Property marketing in Ireland](https://www.hypedigital.ie/services/property-ai-ireland): Editorial property content for developers and estate agents.
- [HYPE Listing Studio](https://www.hypedigital.ie/property): Editorial content studio for property brands. From €1,500/month + VAT.

## About

- Based in Cork, Ireland. Service-area business covering County Cork and all of Ireland.
- 22+ active clients across hospitality, leisure, retail, food and drink, and property.
- Winner of Best Use of Digital by a Start-Up, Cork Digital Marketing Awards 2020.
- Five-year partnership with The Shelbourne Bar (Cork), HYPE's longest.
- Film, social media and PR under one roof.
